description: The pace at which a scheduled campaign starts patients, so messages leave at a rate the provider accepts.

fields.label: Patients started per batch
fields.description: The number of patients started in one batch, between 1 and 500. Progress is saved after each batch, so a run that stops loses at most this many starts.

fields.label: Seconds before the next batch
fields.description: The wait before the next batch, between 10 and 3600 seconds. A batch of 60 every 60 seconds is 60 patients a minute.

name: CRM Cohort Pace Settings
